abstract: This study examines a causal relationship between fiscal pressure and the market structure of government‐controlled factors of production, by exploiting a city‐level panel data set on urban land transactions in China. We find that in the face of higher fiscal pressure, local governments tend to transfer fewer land parcels and make the urban land market more concentrated. This kind of concentration, in turn, will lead to higher housing prices. This study has implications for other countries where the government controls certain types of production factors, such as land or natural resources.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国城市土地交易的面板数据，探讨了财政压力与政府控制生产要素市场结构之间的因果关系。研究发现，面对较高的财政压力，地方政府倾向于减少土地出让地块数量，导致城市土地市场更加集中。这种集中化进而推高了住房价格。本研究对于政府控制土地或自然资源等生产要素的其他国家具有借鉴意义。

abstract: This paper robustly connects observed portfolio choices to correlations of individual income shocks with an aggregate shock (or, equivalently, with stock market returns). The share of nonparticipating individuals displaying a positive correlation, and therefore a negative hedging demand for stocks, is above 79% in both our samples. Furthermore, correlations predict nonparticipation to the equity market, also out-of-sample and for the same individual over time. These results support the traditional hedging motive explanation for nonparticipation. Such new insight owes to the income shocks comovements across individuals, which we model and exploit to identify correlations. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: This work was supported by Inquire Europe, Observatoire de l’Epargne Européenne (OEE), and The Italian Ministry of Education, University and Research (MIUR) Department of Excellence Award for years 2018–2022 and 2023–2027. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06893 .
abstract_zh: 本文将观察到的投资组合选择与个人收入冲击和总体冲击（或等价地，与股票市场收益）之间的相关性稳健地联系起来。在我们的两个样本中，表现出正相关、从而对股票具有负对冲需求的未参与个体比例均高于79%。此外，相关性能够预测股票市场的未参与行为，这一结论在样本外以及同一主体跨时间的情况下同样成立。这些结果支持了将未参与归因于传统对冲动机的解释。这一新见解得益于个体之间收入冲击的共同变动，我们对此进行建模并加以利用以识别相关性。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接收。资助：本研究得到Inquire Europe、欧洲储蓄观察站（OEE）以及意大利教育、大学和研究部（MIUR）2018—2022年和2023—2027年卓越部门奖的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06893获取。

abstract: Motivated by the emerging needs of tailored intervention for heterogeneous populations in preventative healthcare applications, we consider a multistage, dynamic decision-making problem in the online setting with unknown model parameters. To deal with the pervasive issue of small sample size in parameter estimation, we develop a novel data-pooling reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that adaptively pools historical data, with three main innovations: (i) the weight of pooling is directly tied to the performance of the decision (measured by regret) as opposed to estimation accuracy in conventional methods; (ii) no parametric assumptions are needed between historical and current data; and (iii) requiring data-sharing only via aggregate statistics, as opposed to patient-level data. Our data-pooling algorithm framework unifies a variety of RL algorithms, and we establish a theoretical performance guarantee that quantifies the regret bound reduction from our adaptive pooling design compared with benchmarks. We substantiate the theoretical development with extensive empirical experiments via a case study in the context of postdischarge intervention to prevent unplanned readmissions, generating practical insights into healthcare management. Our algorithm enables organizations to leverage public data or published studies for patient management and supports policymakers in promoting aggregate data sharing to enhance population health outcomes. This paper was accepted by Carri Chan, healthcare management. Funding: X. Chen was supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants NSFC-72171205 and NSFC-72394361] and Shenzhen Science and Technology Innovations Committee [Grant RCXY 20210609103124047]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03880 .
abstract_zh: 受预防性医疗应用中针对异质性人群定制干预的新兴需求启发，我们研究了一个在线环境下具有未知模型参数的多阶段动态决策问题。为应对参数估计中普遍存在的小样本问题，我们提出了一种新颖的数据池化强化学习（RL）算法，该算法能够自适应地汇集历史数据，具有三项主要创新：（i）池化权重直接与决策性能（以遗憾值衡量）挂钩，而非传统方法中的估计精度；（ii）历史数据与当前数据之间无需参数假设；（iii）仅需通过聚合统计量进行数据共享，而非患者级数据。我们的数据池化算法框架统一了多种RL算法，并建立了理论性能保证，量化了相较于基准方法，我们的自适应池化设计所带来的遗憾界缩减。我们通过出院后干预以防止非计划再入院的案例研究，以大量实证实验验证了理论发展，生成了对医疗管理具有实践意义的洞见。我们的算法使组织能够利用公共数据或已发表研究进行患者管理，并支持政策制定者推动聚合数据共享以改善人群健康结果。本文由Carri Chan接受，医疗管理领域。资助：X. Chen获得国家自然科学基金[项目号NSFC-72171205和NSFC-72394361]以及深圳市科技创新委员会[项目号RCXY 20210609103124047]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03880获取。

abstract: This study leverages advanced text-analysis techniques to investigate how increased product market rivalry, induced by Chinese import competition, affects innovation among incumbent U.S. firms in the electronic and electrical appliance industry. We measure the similarity between the product descriptions of U.S. firms and those of Chinese importers, thus capturing firm-level competitive pressure. Employing a continuous difference-in-differences framework, we compare innovation outcomes of U.S. firms more directly competing with Chinese importers to those facing lower competitive pressure over a five-year period before and after initial Chinese market entry. We find that incumbent U.S. firms significantly increase their quality-weighted patent production, create more new-product patents, and strategically diversify into new technological and business segments when confronted with heightened competition. Our findings highlight the role of import-driven rivalry in stimulating strategic innovation and illustrate how text-based similarity measures can effectively quantify firm-level competition, providing novel methodological tools for strategy scholars. This paper was accepted by Maria Guadalupe, business strategy. Funding: B. Cassiman acknowledges financial support from the Fonds Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek [Grants G010324N and G071417N]. D. Wehrheim acknowledges financial support from Grant Ref. PID2024-155952NB-I00, funded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by ESF+, ERDF “A way of making Europe”, European Union. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08304 .
abstract_zh: 本研究运用先进的文本分析技术，考察由中国进口竞争所引致的市场竞争加剧如何影响美国电子与电气设备行业在位企业的创新行为。我们测度美国企业与中国进口商产品描述之间的相似度，从而捕捉企业层面的竞争压力。采用连续型双重差分框架，我们在中国首次进入市场前后的五年期间，比较与中国进口商竞争更为直接的美国企业与面临较低竞争压力的企业之间的创新结果。我们发现，当面临竞争加剧时，美国在位企业显著增加了其质量加权专利产出，创造了更多新产品专利，并战略性地向新的技术与业务领域进行多元化拓展。我们的发现凸显了进口驱动的竞争在激发战略性创新方面的作用，并说明了基于文本的相似度测度如何能够有效量化企业层面的竞争，为战略学者提供了新颖的方法论工具。本文由Maria Guadalupe（商业战略领域）接受。资助：B. abstract: Voting rules may implement the will of society when all eligible voters vote, and only them. However, they may fail to do so when sybil (fake or duplicate) votes are present and when only some honest (non-sybil) voters actively participate. As this is often the case, our aim here is to address social choice in the presence of sybils and voter abstention. To do so, we build upon the framework of Reality-aware Social Choice: we assume the status quo as an ever-present distinguished alternative, and study status quo Enforcing (SQE) voting rules , which add virtual votes in support of the status quo. We characterize the tradeoff between safety and liveness (the ability of active honest voters to maintain/change the status quo, respectively) in several domains, and show that the voting rules are often optimal. Our characterization identifies the exact conditions under which mechanisms remain both resilient to sybils and responsive to verified participation, offering a quantitative tool for designers to measure the benefit of increased participation and verified identities. We comment on the applicability of our methods and analyses to the governance of digital communities.

abstract_zh: 投票规则在全体合格选民参与投票时，能够实现社会意愿，且仅在此情况下成立。然而，当存在虚假（伪造或重复）投票，且仅有部分诚实（非虚假）选民积极参与时，这些规则可能失效。鉴于这种情况普遍存在，本文旨在解决存在虚假投票和选民弃权时的社会选择问题。为此，我们基于"现实感知社会选择"框架展开研究：将现状视为始终存在的特殊备选项，并研究"现状强制执行"投票规则——该规则通过增加支持现状的虚拟投票来实现。我们在多个领域刻画了安全性与活跃性（分别指活跃诚实选民维持/改变现状的能力）之间的权衡关系，并证明这些投票规则通常具有最优性。我们的刻画揭示了机制在保持对虚假投票的韧性同时，又能对已验证参与做出响应的确切条件，为设计者提供了衡量参与度提升与身份验证效益的量化工具。最后，我们讨论了研究方法与分析结果在数字社区治理中的适用性。本文为订阅内容预览，需通过机构登录以获取访问权限。
title: Safe voting: resilience to abstention and sybils
title_zh: 安全投票：对弃权与女巫攻击的鲁棒性

abstract: Abstract Governments in EMDEs routinely intervene in agricultural markets to stabilize food prices in response to adverse shocks. Such interventions involve a large increase in the procurement and redistribution of agricultural output, which we refer to as a redistributive policy shock. What is the impact of a redistributive policy shock on inflation and the distribution of consumption among rich and poor households? We build a two‐sector‐two‐agent NK‐DSGE model and estimate it for India using Bayesian methods. We characterize optimal monetary policy and show that the welfare costs of redistributive policy shocks are significantly higher under nonoptimized rules.
abstract_zh: 摘要 新兴市场与发展中经济体（EMDEs）的政府经常干预农产品市场，以应对不利冲击并稳定食品价格。此类干预涉及农产品采购和再分配的大幅增加，我们将其称为再分配政策冲击。再分配政策冲击对通货膨胀以及富裕和贫困家庭之间消费分布的影响是什么？我们构建了一个两部门、两主体的新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡（NK-DSGE）模型，并采用贝叶斯方法对印度进行估计。我们刻画了最优货币政策，并表明在非优化规则下，再分配政策冲击的福利成本显著更高。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Redistributive Policy Shocks and Monetary Policy with Heterogeneous Agents
title_zh: 再分配政策冲击与异质性主体下的货币政策

abstract: Although numerous studies compare the R&D performance of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and nonstate-owned enterprises (NSOEs), few investigate the underlying mechanisms. Using a novel data set on the market value of patents held by Chinese publicly listed firms, we find that SOEs generate lower private economic value from innovation than NSOEs, while the scientific value of their innovations does not differ significantly. Our analysis suggests that the ownership-related gap in R&D performance arises more from differences in firm objectives than from differences in capabilities. Specifically, SOEs exhibit weaker profit-seeking incentives, which lead to lower private returns on innovation. These findings imply that SOEs' R&D activities generate greater positive externalities than those of NSOEs, underscoring the distinctive social contributions of SOE innovation and its nonsubstitutability by NSOE innovation.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量研究比较了国有企业与非国有企业在研发绩效上的差异，但鲜有研究深入探讨其背后的机制。利用一项关于中国上市公司所持专利市场价值的新数据集，我们发现国有企业从创新中获得的私人经济价值低于非国有企业，而两者创新的科学价值并无显著差异。我们的分析表明，所有制相关的研发绩效差距更多源于企业目标的不同，而非能力的差异。具体而言，国有企业表现出较弱的利润追求激励，这导致其创新带来的私人回报较低。这些发现意味着，国有企业的研发活动相比非国有企业产生了更大的正外部性，凸显了国有企业创新的独特社会贡献及其非国有企业创新所不可替代的特性。
